The main takeaway from our work is that

there exists an optimal tradeoff between the number of devices and the level of asynchrony that minimizes training time, and that this tradeoff is highly dependent on both the model and the underlying hardware.
a single-node optimizer can be extended to a multiple-node setting, but the optimizer must take into consideration a new set of tradeoffs that arise in a distributed system.
the design of a deep learning training system is a tradeoff between hardware and statistical efficiency, and that this tradeoff is best managed using a predictive model of training time.
